text: The woman who fixed our roof charges very fair prices.
ir: (assert (e1 charge :tense pres :subj (m1 woman :det the :rel (e2 fix :tense past :subj m1 :obj (m2 roof :poss (m3 we :pron)))) :obj (m4 price :num pl :adj (fair :adv very))))

text: The book that Sam recommended was surprisingly short.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 book :det the :rel (e2 recommend :tense past :subj (m2 Sam :propn) :obj m1)) :attr (short :adv surprisingly)))

text: I found the keys that you were looking for.
ir: (assert (e1 find :tense past :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 key :det the :num pl :rel (e2 look :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m3 you :pron) :obl-for m2))))

text: The chair Maria is sitting on belongs to my aunt.
ir: (assert (e1 belong :tense pres :subj (m1 chair :det the :rel (e2 sit :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m2 Maria :propn) :obl-on m1)) :obl-to (m3 aunt :poss (m4 I :pron))))

text: Tom said that the bus was late.
ir: (assert (e1 say :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :comp (e2 be :tense past :subj (m2 bus :det the) :attr late)))

text: Maria thinks the new manager is very friendly.
ir: (assert (e1 think :tense pres :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :comp (e2 be :tense pres :subj (m2 manager :det the :adj new) :attr (friendly :adv very))))

text: We decided to rent a small cabin.
ir: (assert (e1 decide :tense past :subj (m1 we :pron) :xcomp (e2 rent :obj (m2 cabin :det a :adj small))))

text: Alex wants to learn Spanish.
ir: (assert (e1 want :tense pres :subj (m1 Alex :propn) :xcomp (e2 learn :obj (m2 Spanish :propn))))

text: The kids tried to catch the frog, but it escaped.
ir: (assert (but (e1 try :tense past :subj (m1 kid :det the :num pl) :xcomp (e2 catch :obj (m2 frog :det the))) (e3 escape :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m2))))
notes: 'it' agrees only with 'the frog' (kids is plural).

text: The man who lives next door owns three dogs.
ir: (assert (e1 own :tense pres :subj (m1 man :det the :rel (e2 live :tense pres :subj m1 :adv next_door)) :obj (m2 dog :det three :num pl)))
notes: 'next door' treated as a multi-word adverb next_door (spec silent on adverbial NPs/idioms).

text: My brother is saving money to buy a car.
ir: (assert (e1 save :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 brother :poss (m2 I :pron)) :obj (m3 money) :purpose (e2 buy :obj (m4 car :det a))))

text: The doctor told Maria that her test results were normal.
ir: (assert (e1 tell :tense past :subj (m1 doctor :det the) :iobj (m2 Maria :propn) :comp (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 result :num pl :compound test :poss (m4 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2)) :attr normal)))
notes: 'Maria' as :iobj of tell (recipient, first object) with a finite :comp; spec silent on tell+NP+that-clause. 'her' can be Maria or the doctor (unknown gender), so two refs.

text: The restaurant that we ate at has closed.
ir: (assert (e1 close :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 restaurant :det the :rel (e2 eat :tense past :subj (m2 we :pron) :obl-at m1))))

text: Sam cooked dinner and Robin washed the dishes.
ir: (assert (and (e1 cook :tense past :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :obj (m2 dinner)) (e2 wash :tense past :subj (m3 Robin :propn) :obj (m4 dish :det the :num pl))))

text: We can take the train or Alex can drive us.
ir: (assert (or (e1 take :mod can :subj (m1 we :pron) :obj (m2 train :det the)) (e2 drive :mod can :subj (m3 Alex :propn) :obj (m4 we :pron))))

text: The girl with the red umbrella waved at us.
ir: (assert (e1 wave :tense past :subj (m1 girl :det the :obl-with (m2 umbrella :det the :adj red)) :obl-at (m3 we :pron)))

text: A tall, quiet man in a grey coat entered the room.
ir: (assert (e1 enter :tense past :subj (m1 man :det a :adj tall :adj quiet :obl-in (m2 coat :det a :adj grey)) :obj (m3 room :det the)))

text: She went to the market to buy some fresh vegetables.
ir: (assert (e1 go :tense past :subj (m1 she :pron :ref none) :obl-to (m2 market :det the) :purpose (e2 buy :obj (m3 vegetable :det some :num pl :adj fresh))))
notes: No feminine/unknown human antecedent in the sentence, so :ref none.

text: The landlord promised to repair the broken heater.
ir: (assert (e1 promise :tense past :subj (m1 landlord :det the) :xcomp (e2 repair :obj (m2 heater :det the :adj broken))))

text: I believe that the meeting starts at ten.
ir: (assert (e1 believe :tense pres :subj (m1 I :pron) :comp (e2 start :tense pres :subj (m2 meeting :det the) :obl-at (m3 ten))))
notes: Clock time 'ten' as a bare mention.

text: Maria asked her brother to feed the cat.
ir: (assert (e1 ask :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 brother :poss (m3 she :pron :ref m1)) :xcomp (e2 feed :obj (m4 cat :det the))))
notes: Object-control 'ask NP to V': NP is :obj, infinitive is :xcomp. 'her' cannot be the brother (masculine).

text: The painting that hangs in the hallway was a gift from my grandfather.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 painting :det the :rel (e2 hang :tense pres :subj m1 :obl-in (m2 hallway :det the))) :attr (m3 gift :det a :obl-from (m4 grandfather :poss (m5 I :pron)))))

text: Tom forgot to lock the back door.
ir: (assert (e1 forget :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :xcomp (e2 lock :obj (m2 door :det the :adj back))))
notes: 'back' treated as an adjective (could be argued to be a compound noun).

text: The students who finished early went outside.
ir: (assert (e1 go :tense past :subj (m1 student :det the :num pl :rel (e2 finish :tense past :subj m1 :adv early)) :adv outside))

text: I know a woman who speaks five languages.
ir: (assert (e1 know :tense pres :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 woman :det a :rel (e2 speak :tense pres :subj m2 :obj (m3 language :det five :num pl)))))

text: Alex baked some cookies, and the children ate them quickly.
ir: (assert (and (e1 bake :tense past :subj (m1 Alex :propn) :obj (m2 cookie :det some :num pl)) (e2 eat :tense past :subj (m3 child :det the :num pl) :obj (m4 they :pron :ref m2) :adv quickly)))
notes: 'them' cannot be 'the children' (subject of its own clause, rule 2).

text: The company announced that it would close two factories.
ir: (assert (e1 announce :tense past :subj (m1 company :det the) :comp (e2 close :mod would :subj (m2 it :pron :ref m1) :obj (m3 factory :det two :num pl))))
notes: Future-in-the-past 'would' annotated as :mod would per spec.

text: Robin hopes to visit Japan.
ir: (assert (e1 hope :tense pres :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :xcomp (e2 visit :obj (m2 Japan :propn))))

text: The man who sold us the car was very honest.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 man :det the :rel (e2 sell :tense past :subj m1 :iobj (m2 we :pron) :obj (m3 car :det the))) :attr (honest :adv very)))

text: The keys to the garage are on the shelf.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 key :det the :num pl :obl-to (m2 garage :det the)) :obl-on (m3 shelf :det the)))

text: Sam wanted to leave, but Robin wanted to stay.
ir: (assert (but (e1 want :tense past :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :xcomp (e2 leave)) (e3 want :tense past :subj (m2 Robin :propn) :xcomp (e4 stay))))

text: The old wooden bridge collapsed during the heavy rain.
ir: (assert (e1 collapse :tense past :subj (m1 bridge :det the :adj old :adj wooden) :obl-during (m2 rain :det the :adj heavy)))

text: A large round table stood in the middle of the kitchen.
ir: (assert (e1 stand :tense past :subj (m1 table :det a :adj large :adj round) :obl-in (m2 middle :det the :obl-of (m3 kitchen :det the))))

text: The teacher explained that the exam had been moved to Friday.
ir: (assert (e1 explain :tense past :subj (m1 teacher :det the) :comp (e2 move :tense past :aspect perf :voice pass :subj (m2 exam :det the) :obl-to (m3 Friday :propn))))

text: Maria plays the piano and her sister sings.
ir: (assert (and (e1 play :tense pres :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 piano :det the)) (e2 sing :tense pres :subj (m3 sister :poss (m4 she :pron :ref m1)))))
notes: 'her' excludes 'sister' itself (a possessor cannot refer to the NP containing it; spec silent on this i-within-i case).

text: The dog that bit the mail carrier belongs to our neighbor.
ir: (assert (e1 belong :tense pres :subj (m1 dog :det the :rel (e2 bite :tense past :subj m1 :obj (m2 carrier :det the :compound mail))) :obl-to (m3 neighbor :poss (m4 we :pron))))

text: I tried to call you, but the line was busy.
ir: (assert (but (e1 try :tense past :subj (m1 I :pron) :xcomp (e2 call :obj (m2 you :pron))) (e3 be :tense past :subj (m3 line :det the) :attr busy)))

text: The mayor said the new park would open in May.
ir: (assert (e1 say :tense past :subj (m1 mayor :det the) :comp (e2 open :mod would :subj (m2 park :det the :adj new) :obl-in (m3 May :propn))))

text: Robin likes to read mystery novels.
ir: (assert (e1 like :tense pres :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :xcomp (e2 read :obj (m2 novel :num pl :compound mystery))))

text: The man I met at the conference works for a small startup.
ir: (assert (e1 work :tense pres :subj (m1 man :det the :rel (e2 meet :tense past :subj (m2 I :pron) :obj m1 :obl-at (m3 conference :det the))) :obl-for (m4 startup :det a :adj small)))

text: The neighbors complained that the music was too loud.
ir: (assert (e1 complain :tense past :subj (m1 neighbor :det the :num pl) :comp (e2 be :tense past :subj (m2 music :det the) :attr (loud :adv too))))

text: Alex opened the window to cool the room.
ir: (assert (e1 open :tense past :subj (m1 Alex :propn) :obj (m2 window :det the) :purpose (e2 cool :obj (m3 room :det the))))

text: The box that the lamp came in is in the garage.
ir: (assert (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 box :det the :rel (e2 come :tense past :subj (m2 lamp :det the) :obl-in m1)) :obl-in (m3 garage :det the)))

text: The committee decided that the festival should be postponed.
ir: (assert (e1 decide :tense past :subj (m1 committee :det the) :comp (e2 postpone :mod should :voice pass :subj (m2 festival :det the))))

text: Tom started to laugh, and the baby began to cry.
ir: (assert (and (e1 start :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :xcomp (e2 laugh)) (e3 begin :tense past :subj (m2 baby :det the) :xcomp (e4 cry))))

text: The hotel that we booked was clean, but the waiters were rude.
ir: (assert (but (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 hotel :det the :rel (e2 book :tense past :subj (m2 we :pron) :obj m1)) :attr clean) (e3 be :tense past :subj (m3 waiter :det the :num pl) :attr rude)))

text: Sam promised Robin that he would return the ladder.
ir: (assert (e1 promise :tense past :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :iobj (m2 Robin :propn) :comp (e2 return :mod would :subj (m3 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obj (m4 ladder :det the))))
notes: 'he' can be Sam or Robin (Robin has unknown gender); 'Robin' as :iobj of promise + that-clause.

text: The farmer hired two workers to help with the harvest.
ir: (assert (e1 hire :tense past :subj (m1 farmer :det the) :obj (m2 worker :det two :num pl) :purpose (e2 help :obl-with (m3 harvest :det the))))
notes: Infinitive read as a purpose clause on 'hired'; an infinitival-relative reading ('workers to help') is close in meaning and v0 has no separate role for it.

text: Everyone agreed that the hike was too long.
ir: (assert (e1 agree :tense past :subj (m1 everyone) :comp (e2 be :tense past :subj (m2 hike :det the) :attr (long :adv too))))
notes: 'everyone' as a bare mention head (not a personal pronoun).

text: The jacket I ordered online arrived with a broken zipper.
ir: (assert (e1 arrive :tense past :subj (m1 jacket :det the :rel (e2 order :tense past :subj (m2 I :pron) :obj m1 :adv online)) :obl-with (m3 zipper :det a :adj broken)))
